maya: Quick shoutout — @jordan stayed until 2AM to untangle that weird quantization regression and also brought homemade brownies for the team. Legend. :brownie: :clap:

jordan: haha i owe you all one. i just followed maya's bisect notes and poked the kernel path. brownies were a bribe. :sweat_smile:

sam: Cookies & debugging? sign me up. also will volunteer to wash dishes and restart the coffee machine if needed :raised_hands:

nora: Big thanks — I paired with Jordan on the flaky e2e that was masking the issue earlier. We got the failing test into a tiny repro too. Team effort! :sparkles:

maya: Putting this on the weekly shoutouts doc and sending a tiny thank-you voucher to Jordan and Nora. Also: can we please rename the kitchen sink to `the debug sink`? :joy:

jordan: I'll take that voucher! But honestly, huge props to Maya for the bisect, and to Nora for chasing the test. Feeling very supported. :heart:

ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen rota updated. Jordan assigned cleanup slot Friday 9–10am. See <https://intranet/redwood/kitchen-rota|kitchen rota>.

sam: Vote: should we institute a Dessert-On-Ship Friday? :banana: :cake: :cookie:

nora: +1 for Dessert-On-Ship Friday. Also tiny note — I uploaded the repro script to the infra repo under `tests/repro/quant_regression.sh` in case anyone needs it.

maya: Official kudos thread: Jordan & Nora, thanks for the late-night rescue. Dropping :tada: in the #all-hands shoutouts tomorrow. And yes, Dessert-On-Ship Friday is now a motion i second.
